title: Trump and His Aides Helped Bolsonaro Flee Brazil and Enter U.S.
summary_full: President Trump ensured Flávio Bolsonaro, who lost a presidential election in Brazil and faces multiple criminal investigations there, could enter the United States, U.S. officials said.
